fullDesc: A Lion Air 737 MAX crashed in October 2018 and an Ethiopian Airlines one in March 2019, killing 346 people in total. A flight control system called MCAS was involved, and the plane was grounded worldwide for about 20 months.
realFacts: Regulators faced questions over how the plane was certified
The plane returned to service in late 2020
Boeing faced further scrutiny over quality in later years
